project.name: msu
project.packageDescription: AI-powered breakfast restaurant operations assistant for handwritten order aggregation, receipts, and ingredient preparation estimates.
constraints: Thai-first workflow for breakfast restaurants serving congee, rice porridge, and kuai chap.
OCR output is untrusted until a staff member reviews low-confidence or incomplete fields.
Prices come from the restaurant menu/price list; the model must not invent prices.
Ingredient estimates come from restaurant-maintained recipes and safety-stock assumptions.
Keep source-order traceability when aggregating multiple order images.
